item.title: Report: Discrimination drives mental health crisis among LGBTQ+ youth
item.description: A new report says LGBTQ+ youth face high rates of anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts, driven by ongoing discrimination.

item.title: Upadacitinib Shows Advantages in Real-World UC Treatment
item.description: Upadacitinib, a JAK1 inhibitor, is associated with lower treatment failure risk and more steroid-free disease stability than five other advanced therapies.

item.title: Trial tests low-dose radiation for brain inflammation in Parkinson's
item.description: Mayo Clinic researchers are investigating whether low-dose radiation therapy can slow Parkinson's progression by targeting brain inflammation.

item.title: Blood test helps clinicians better identify brain injury severity
item.description: Clinician-scientists aim to expand blood-based biomarker tests for traumatic brain injury to improve identification and escalation of care.
